title: An Assortment Of Spells
description: A work-in-progress spell addon for Iron's Spells and Spellbooks.
body:
A work-in-progress spell addon for Iron's Spells and Spellbooks.

Current spells:

- Levitate: levitates the target
- Sunlight Lance: a holy aoe projectile attack
- Updraft: recastable dash move, great for movement and elytra boosting.


REQUIRES IRON'S SPELLS AND SPELLBOOKS
